label: copy phase around recalling p (plus original-phase step after e)
explanation: Strongest activations (top quartile, up to max) are in the delimiter/copy phase at steps that output p (out_tok==p: 85% active), with weaker activation on the step before (next_out==p) and the step after (input p). Peaks on runs of repeated p being copied. A secondary component fires in the original phase on the step after an input e (62% precision). The remaining ~45% of activation mass is a diffuse low-magnitude (<0.2 of max) background over early copy-phase steps (recall_idx 1-4) with no token specificity. Does not fire at t=0 and rarely in the original phase otherwise.
